LocalBotz default. The picker lists whatever LM Studio / Ollama actually has live, not a fixed list — Qwen3.5 is only the fallback.

note: ChatLLM lists marketing names (e.g. 'GPT 6 Astra', 'Fable 5.2', 'Gemini 4 Carbon'). Those are NOT provider API model IDs. LocalBotz only sends a model to a provider when the provider's own API accepts that ID. Entries marked 'reference-only' are shown in the catalogue for comparison and are NOT sent to any API until their real API ID is confirmed. Entries marked 'verified' use the API IDs LocalBotz already supports. The Available-models picker in the app stays availability-driven: a model only appears as usable when its provider is reachable / its key is set, or the live probe returns it.
source: https://chatllm.abacus.ai/ — ChatLLM Teams page, read 2026-11-14. Used as a reference for the model list only.
